title: The Nightly Parking Charge on a Resort Lodging Stay
content:
Parking beyond what a Resort Lodging unit type includes is charged at the unit type's nightly parking charge for each such space, and what that nightly charge comes to turns on whether the household skis the collective's mountains on a season pass. The pass records read are the household's season passes under the Season Pass Programme, read for their standing and for the season they are held for.

Where the reservation asks for more parking spaces than the unit type includes and a season pass stands active for the season of the stay on the household account, that nightly charge is taken less the passholder parking share, being less 25 percent of it.

Where the reservation asks for no more spaces than the unit type includes, nothing is charged for parking.

In every other case the unit type's nightly parking charge is taken as it stands.

## The spaces each unit type includes

| Unit type | Parking spaces included |
| --- | --- |
| Base Village Inn Room | 0 |
| Slopeside Studio | 1 |
| Slopeside One-Bedroom Residence | 1 |
| Slopeside Two-Bedroom Residence | 2 |
| Mountain Lodge Suite | 1 |
| Summit Penthouse Residence | 2 |
| Private Mountain Chalet | 4 |

### Three hypothetical reservations on a Slopeside Two-Bedroom Residence

The unit type includes 2 spaces and its nightly parking charge is taken here as 32.00 USD.

A reservation asking for 3 spaces asks for more than the 2 included; where a season pass stands active for the season of the stay on the household account, the nightly charge is taken less 25 percent of it, which is 24.00 USD a night for the space beyond those included.

A reservation asking for 2 spaces asks for no more than the unit type includes, and nothing is charged for parking, whatever the household holds.

A reservation asking for 3 spaces where no season pass stands active for the season of the stay is charged the nightly parking charge of 32.00 USD as it stands, for the space beyond those included.
